description: Routing evals for the evolution end-to-end smoke fixture. Uses the should_trigger schema (the legacy expected_behavior schema silently yields 0% routing accuracy). One case (kelvin_conversion) is a deliberate baseline gap: its query shares zero 4+ char keywords with the baseline description (celsius/fahrenheit/converts/temperatures/...), so it genuinely fails to route until the evolution cycle broadens the description to include a Kelvin-related word. Do not rephrase kelvin_conversion's query to reuse an existing baseline keyword (e.g. 'celsius') -- that silently defeats the gap by making it pass for the wrong reason, which is exactly the bug this fixture is meant to catch.

evaluations.notes: Previously '20C to F please' -- the 4+ char keyword matcher can never resolve 2-char unit shorthand like '20C'/'F', so that query failed permanently regardless of description content, unrelated to and polluting the deliberate Kelvin gap below. Rephrased to a normal true positive.

DELIBERATE BASELINE GAP: shares no keyword with the baseline description (previously used 'Convert 300 Kelvin to Celsius.', which already contains 'Celsius' -- a baseline keyword -- so it passed at baseline for the wrong reason and never actually exercised the gap). E2E-PASS fix broadens the description to include 'Kelvin', flipping this case to green for the right reason.

evaluations.query: How many kilometers are in 5 miles?
